description: Give the site a category tree and make it a wiki, or change its tree. A wiki's pages live in its categories, each with a version and a history of every save, and are written with save_wiki_page, not write_site. The tree is sent whole: each node's slug is its path segment, and its metadataKeys are the facts a page under it carries, a select key becoming a filter on the category's page.

hidden.description: Back office: never listed unless asked for by path

mainArticle.description: The article this category is about, as tagPath/slug

metadataKeys.description: The facts a page here carries; select keys become facets

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

tree.description: The top-level categories, each with its children

name: set_wiki
title: Make a site a wiki
